name: Whitford Credential - Master of Science in Data Analytics
description: Soulbound digital credential for the Master of Science in Data Analytics (NFQ Level 9) from Whitford Global College, Dublin, a fictional college created for an NCI Blockchain Technologies project. It proves the award was issued by the college. No name or grades are stored on-chain; employers verify the certificate file with the salt given to the graduate. The credential cannot be transferred and can be revoked by the Registrar.
